mentions.name: FollowGuard
mentions.description: This app is a privacy-first Instagram analytics tool that parses official Instagram GDPR data exports entirely client-side in the browser. Built as a Vue 3 + TypeScript SPA with no backend, all ZIP extraction and JSON parsing happen locally so user data never leaves their machine. It includes a Security Audit feature that helps users find suspicious login activity in their own data.
mentions.problem: Unofficial 'unfollower' apps require login credentials and use unofficial APIs, causing people to lose their Instagram accounts. Staying safe instead requires users to navigate an 11-step manual export process on Instagram, creating UX friction for non-technical users.
mentions.audience: Non-technical Instagram users who want insights on their account data
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building FollowGuard (https://followguard.app) - it's a privacy-first Instagram analytics tool.

I got tired of seeing people lose their accounts to "unfollower" apps that require login credentials and use unofficial APIs. Instead, I built this to parse official Instagram GDPR data exports 100% client-side in the browser.
